## Deltas from ticket

The [release build policy](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/9f99a55754/buildScripts/README.md#L65-L70) puts the tracked `seo.json` write in release preparation. This PR exercises that generator and checks the output locally. The ten availability flags accompany the same catalog publication: seven repaired planning examples, File Explorer, Gantt Basic and Offscreen Canvas. Data Pipeline already had its light flag on the base.

## Test Evidence

Six existing Chromium gallery regressions passed, covering catalog counts, launch, selection and scroll retention, lazy covers and saved light preferences. The separate visitor pass verified the six new links and all 16 pairs. The catalog changes from 156 to 162 distinct IDs and from 67 to 83 records advertising a published light partner.
